item.title: The Challenge of Forgiving Those Who Stopped Thinking
item.description: When Hannah Arendt wrote her famous essay on the banality of evil, she put the spotlight on those who expected forgiveness because they just followed orders. Venezuela now faces the same dilemma

item.title: A Nationwide Screening to Honor July 28
item.description: An activist network inside and outside Venezuela will screen the documentary “De Macedonia con amor” in 20 cities around the world, including an event at the Ciudad Universitaria in Caracas

item.title: The Politics of Appearances in Post-Maduro Venezuela
item.description: Chavismo always knew how to maneuver politics to produce convenient international headlines, leaving out the small print that really matters. The Rodríguez regime is doing it again
